name: New website from scratch
description: A complete site from a description: plan, copy, design, code and a final review.
prompt:
Build a website for [business name], a [what you do] in [city].
It's for [who your visitors are], and the main goal is to get them to [book / call / buy / sign up].
Pages: [Home, About, Services, Contact].
Tone: [friendly / premium / playful]. Colours: [your colours, or "you choose"].
Must include: [prices, opening hours, map, reviews, contact form].

name: Landing page that converts
description: One page with one goal: a clear offer, proof and a strong call to action.
prompt:
Build a one-page landing page for [product or offer].
It's for [who it's for], who struggle with [their problem].
The one action I want: [book a demo / buy / join the waitlist].
Real proof I can show: [numbers, reviews, logos, guarantees].
Answer these doubts near the button: [price, time, what happens next].

name: Improve an imported site
description: Fix and polish a site you imported, keeping its content and brand.
prompt:
Improve this site without changing what it says or its brand colours.
Fix bugs and broken links, make it work well on phones, improve accessibility and loading speed, and tighten the visual details.
Also: [anything specific that bothers you].

name: Redesign: new look, same content
description: Keep the words and pages, change the visual design completely.
prompt:
Give this site a new look and keep all its content and pages.
New style: [modern and minimal / warm and friendly / bold and colourful / luxury].
Keep: [logo, brand colour, anything else].
Sites whose style I like: [links or descriptions].

name: Research, then build
description: The Research agent studies the market and competitors first, then the team builds a better page.
prompt:
Research [type of business] in [city or market]: what competitors offer, what customers praise and complain about.
Then build a website for [business name] that does better than them, for [who the visitors are].
Main goal: [what visitors should do].

name: Build from a sketch or screenshot
description: Turn an attached sketch, wireframe or screenshot into a real page.
prompt:
Build the page shown in the attached image (attach it with the paperclip).
Follow its layout and sections. [Keep its colours / use these colours instead: …].
The page is for [business], and the text should [be written for … / stay as in the image].

name: Restaurant or café
description: Menu with prices, opening hours, map, booking and local search.
prompt:
Build a website for [name], a [restaurant / café / bakery] in [neighbourhood, city].
Show the menu with prices: [paste your menu or main dishes].
Opening hours: [hours]. Address: [address]. Phone or WhatsApp: [number].
Booking: [table booking form / WhatsApp button / phone only].
Atmosphere: [cosy / modern / traditional]. Language: [language of the site].

name: Local service business
description: Plumbers, salons, clinics, garages: services with prices, area served, reviews and quick contact.
prompt:
Build a website for [business name], a [plumber / hair salon / dental clinic / garage] in [city].
Services and prices: [list your main services, with prices or "on request"].
Area served: [neighbourhoods or cities]. Opening hours: [hours].
How customers reach me: [phone, WhatsApp, booking form]. Address: [address, or "we come to you"].
Real reviews or numbers I can show: [reviews, years in business, or "none yet"].

name: Portfolio
description: Show your work, your story and how to hire you.
prompt:
Build a portfolio for [your name], a [designer / photographer / developer / architect].
Projects to show: [3 to 6 projects, one line each].
Who I want to reach: [clients, studios, recruiters].
How they contact me: [email, form, LinkedIn]. Style: [minimal / bold / editorial].

name: Blog or content site
description: Articles and guides that answer real questions, with clear navigation and search basics.
prompt:
Build a content site about [topic] for [who reads it].
Start with these articles: [3 to 5 article titles or questions people ask].
Tone: [expert / friendly / practical]. Language: [language].
What readers should do after reading: [subscribe / contact us / buy].

name: Product page
description: Sell one product: benefits, details, reviews, questions and a clear buy button.
prompt:
Build a product page for [product name], which [what it does].
Price: [price]. Delivery and payment: [delivery time, cash on delivery, returns].
Who buys it: [customers]. Main benefits: [3 benefits].
Real reviews or proof I have: [reviews, numbers, or "none yet"].

name: Event page
description: Date, programme, speakers, venue and registration.
prompt:
Build a page for [event name] on [date] at [venue, city].
Programme: [main sessions or schedule]. Speakers or guests: [names].
Registration: [form with name and email / ticket link]. Price: [free / price].
Who it's for: [audience].

name: Make it multilingual
description: Add more languages, a language switcher and right-to-left layouts.
prompt:
Make this site available in [English], [French] and [Arabic].
The main language is [main language]. Translate every page naturally for local readers, add a language switcher in the header, and lay out Arabic right to left.

name: Legal pages
description: Privacy policy and legal notice, linked from every footer.
prompt:
Add a privacy policy and a legal notice (mentions légales) to this site.
The business: [company name, legal form, registration number, address, contact email].
The site's host: [host name and address].
What the site collects: [contact form, newsletter, nothing].

name: Add a dark mode
description: A dark theme that follows the visitor's system, with a toggle.
prompt: Add a dark mode to this site. It should follow the visitor's system setting, have a toggle in the header that remembers the choice, and keep every text readable.

name: Contact and booking forms
description: Forms with good fields, validation, errors and success messages.
prompt:
Add a [contact / booking / quote request] form to the [Contact] page.
Fields: [name, email, phone, date, number of guests, message].
After sending, tell visitors: [what happens next, e.g. "we reply within a day"].

name: Boost conversions
description: More visitors take the main action: clearer offer, real proof, less friction.
prompt:
Make this site better at getting visitors to [book / call / buy / sign up].
What visitors usually worry about: [price, trust, time, delivery].
Real proof I can add: [reviews, numbers, guarantees, logos]. Don't invent any.

name: SEO and speed checkup
description: Search and sharing tags, structured data, faster loading and a bug check.
prompt:
Improve how this site appears in search and loads.
The searches people should find it for: [e.g. "café in Casablanca", "wedding photographer Rabat"].
City or area served: [city].

name: Accessibility audit
description: Check and fix the site against WCAG 2.2 AA, then review it.
prompt:
Check this site against WCAG 2.2 AA and fix every problem: contrast, keyboard use, focus, labels, headings and alt text.
List what you changed in the review.

name: Code cleanup
description: Tidy the code without changing how the site looks or works.
prompt: Clean up this site's code without changing how it looks or works: remove unused CSS and code, merge duplicates and make the formatting consistent.

name: 3D website
description: A site with a real 3D object at its heart, plus depth effects, fast on phones and with still fallbacks.
prompt:
Build a website for [business or product] with 3D at its heart.
The 3D star: [a rotating product / a 3D logo / a low-poly globe / floating shapes in the hero].
Visitors should be able to [drag to rotate it / see it follow the mouse / watch it turn as they scroll].
Pages: [Home, Product, Contact]. Tone: [futuristic / playful / premium]. Colours: [your colours, or "you choose"].
Keep it fast on phones, and show a still picture when 3D isn't available.

name: Add 3D to my site
description: Add a 3D object, tilting cards or parallax layers to a site you already have, without changing its content.
prompt:
Add 3D to this site without changing its content or text.
What I'd like: [a 3D object in the hero / cards that tilt towards the mouse / parallax layers / flip cards].
The object: [describe it, e.g. our logo in 3D, a phone showing the app, a coffee cup].
Keep it fast, respect reduced motion, and keep a still fallback.
